comment.comment: The lexer has one comment form: // to end of line. There is no block comment.
comment.name: comment.line.double-slash.hsx

string.comment: Strings have no escape sequences and cannot span a line, so the match is deliberately simple.
string.name: string.quoted.double.hsx

declaration.comment: The five keywords that introduce a declaration, each followed by the name it declares.

port-reference.comment: `port` in value position: release: port confirm_handover
port-reference.name: keyword.other.port.hsx

archetype.comment: Every name the settlement standard library exports.
archetype.name: support.class.archetype.hsx

type-constructor.comment: money(SAR) and id(vehicle): applied types, so only before an open paren.
type-constructor.name: support.function.type.hsx

scalar-type.comment: The two port field types that take no argument.
scalar-type.name: support.type.hsx

contextual-keyword.comment: Identifiers the checker gives meaning to in one position each.
contextual-keyword.name: keyword.other.hsx

duration.comment: Fixed ISO-8601 durations. Days and weeks only; calendar months are refused by the compiler.
duration.name: constant.other.duration.hsx

percent.comment: Exact to a basis point: at most two fraction digits.
percent.name: constant.numeric.percentage.hsx

currency.comment: Three capital letters is a currency code everywhere the language accepts one.
currency.name: support.constant.currency.hsx

entry-key.comment: An identifier introducing an entry: `payer: buyer`, `fees { ... }`, `on_cancel(funded) { ... }`.
entry-key.name: variable.other.member.hsx
